points: Led internal LLM workshops and launched an internal open source program, enabling **50+ engineers** to build and contribute to AI powered open source projects.

Built a Snowflake Cortex Agent DataOps solution that monitored **50+ production pipelines and 1,000+ daily runs**, surfaced data quality issues with AI generated root cause insights, and sent automated Slack alerts.

Built a multi agent workflow that automated the migration of **500+ Qlik reports** to Power BI: it extracted metadata, translated business logic to SQL, generated semantic models, rebuilt dashboards and validated accuracy against the legacy platform.

Delivered data and AI solutions for **5 enterprise clients** across banking, airlines, life sciences and defense, including Snowflake Bronze, Silver and Gold platforms that gave analytics and ML teams AI ready data.
Managed **4 engineers and 3 client stakeholders**, automating data workflows with Apache Airflow and MWAA.
Built sentiment analysis pipelines over **5,000+ documents** in production, and object detection models (YOLOv4, TensorFlow Lite) with **85% real time accuracy** at the edge.
Designed a web crawler API and a Chrome extension with Auth0, and wrote developer documentation for AI agent usage.

about.intro: Engineer, builder, storyteller and advocate working at the intersection of AI, data and developer communities. Six years in tech.

sections.title: The unexpected start
text: I started in 2019 with a lot of uncertainty. Engineering was not the original plan, but once I began, I decided to move forward with full effort.
I learned by doing. Every line of code and every failed build was a lesson. Gradually, I built confidence through action rather than theory.
sections.alt: Monika Rajput speaking to a full room

sections.title: Learning to build
text: I spent years as a Data Scientist, diving into NLP and computer vision. But I realized that building a model was not enough. I wanted to ship products.
I learned the end to end journey, from consulting on strategy to writing the frontend code needed to get a tool into a user's hands. I became someone who learns whatever is needed to build.
sections.alt: Monika Rajput presenting at DevOpsDays Kerala

sections.title: The reset
text: In 2023, the recession hit and I lost my job. Suddenly I had no title and no professional identity. It was a difficult reset.
But that void became a canvas. I started sharing my journey publicly, turning the silence into a story. This moment taught me that my value is not tied to a company, but to my ability to create.
sections.alt: Monika Rajput in an interview on SheMeansBusiness

sections.title: Community and public journey
text: That transition led me to the stage. I have mentored and judged at 40+ hackathons and events, and learned the art of technical storytelling.
Most importantly, I have worked to inspire builders from tier 3 backgrounds to see that their path is possible.
sections.alt: CNCF Ambassadors panel at KubeCon CloudNativeCon India 2025

sections.title: The Monika Rajput Show
text: The Monika Rajput Show (TMS) was born out of pure curiosity. It is a space for deep conversations with the builders of cloud, data, AI and open source.

It is about learning in public and connecting the dots between people and progress. Through TMS, I have interviewed founders and engineers who are shaping the next decade of technology. Available on Spotify and YouTube.
sections.alt: Monika Rajput interviewing a guest for The Monika Rajput Show

sections.title: What excites me now
text: I want to thrive where technology meets utility. I am focused on building AI agents, advocating for developer first products, and helping companies grow through trust and technical depth.
I love working across product and design, representing a brand on a global stage, and building the storytelling that makes complex technology human.
